long_description:
Join Heather Burkart, eRYT500, on Sunday November 8th from 9:00am-5:00pm at Healium Hot Yoga-Bay View’s Cozy Studio for a full-day intensive focused on meditation as a personalized practice.

Meditation is not a one-size-fits-all practice. This immersive workshop explores traditional and modern meditation techniques through the Ayurvedic lens, helping participants discover practices that align with their unique constitution and current state of balance. Through guided experiences, discussion, and self-inquiry, students will develop practical tools for cultivating focus, resilience, self-awareness, and inner calm while gaining confidence in guiding meditation practices for others. Class will not be hot/heated. 

$125 early bird pricing - sign up by November 1st

$150 full price - after November 1st 

This event is a Healium 300 hour Yoga Teacher Training Module; it is also available for 8 Continuing Education Credits with Yoga Alliance. Open to ALL curious students, teacher and non-teacher alike!
